definitions: A type of American whiskey made primarily from corn.
A member of a French royal family, especially the one that ruled France from the 16th to the 19th century.
A plain or chocolate-flavoured biscuit consisting of two rectangular biscuits with a creamy filling.
examples: He enjoyed a glass of bourbon on the rocks.
The Bourbon dynasty played a significant role in European history.
She dunked a bourbon biscuit into her tea.
